title: CAR-T Cells Combined With Dasatinib for Patients With Relapsed and/or Refractory B-cell Hematological Malignancies

sections.abstract: A Study of CD19/BCMA-targeted CAR-T Cells Combined With Dasatinib for Patients With Relapsed and/or Refractory B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia, B-cell Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma and Multiple Myeloma.
